summary: Describes the authors' experience building a SOAP-based NETCONF client and server. It describes an alternative SOAP binding that does not interoperate with an implementation following RFC 4743, and discusses how existing SOAP tools can reduce development effort. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: Some people built a tool for managing network gear by using ready-made software parts. They wrote down what they learned, including one place where their version wouldn't work with the official one.
